lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are organized in four distinct horizontal tiers. A specific triad of high-intensity spots forms an obtuse triangle in the mid-flank region posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical striations of higher pixel luminance intersect the horizontal rows, forming a structural grid where spots are positioned primarily at the intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A singular, prominent horizontal ridge runs across the upper third of the visible flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with light values on the superior edge and shadow values on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of high-luminance circular nodes concentrated on the posterior half of the fin surface.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin shows a unique arrangement of high-luminance spots, particularly a dense cluster of smaller points near the distal trailing edge.
